simple.summary: עֲקַלְקַל (ʻăqalqal) means winding First listed occurrence: Judg 5 6.

definitions.full: H6128. aqalqal [ עֲקַלְקָל ] adjective intensive crooked ; — feminine plural עֲקַלְקַלּוֺת אֳרָחוֺת Judg 5:6 i.e. roundabout paths (GFM); suffix עֲקַלִקַלּוֺתָם Psa 125:5 their crooked-nesses .
